z_alpha_definition: alpha_norm centered and divided by the population SD of the fixed 11-level grid (sqrt(mean((alpha - mean(alpha))^2)))

semantic_orientation.neutral: ASCII case-insensitive alphabetically earlier minus later
semantic_orientation.scope: semantic components and final-input-token AB/BA projection deltas; position components are unchanged

prompt_template: XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX, {option1} or {option2}? Please answer only with {option1} or {option2}.
inference_unit: lexical pair within each model; models analyzed separately
p_value_reporting: Unadjusted model-specific p values are primary; Holm-adjusted columns are retained as a cross-model sensitivity summary
